recommendation: Keep the source fix. Remaining DataElement strings are historical, external, inactive, or legacy terminology names and should only be renamed under a separate terminology/content decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13094 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested eliminating the DataElement resource, replacing it with StructureDefinition logical models, and adding narrative describing logical-model use for data elements.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by d0802c9b75, which cited #13094 and removed DataElement references from many pages while updating StructureDefinition context. Follow-up commit 29576ed0ef commented DataElement out in fhir.ini and changed history links to StructureDefinition.
additional_context: Current source has no source/dataelement directory, lists DataElement as removed in history, and has StructureDefinition/logical-model narrative explaining StructureDefinition.kind=logical, ElementDefinitions, and data dictionaries. A 2020 implementers Zulip thread confirms the intended interpretation that a data element is either a stand-alone logical model or a reference to an element in a resource, data type, profile, or logical model.
reconciliation: The commit removed the stale DataElement page from source/hierarchy.xml, changed active Coding and Quantity extension profile descriptions so they no longer say DataElement, and changed the active ISO 11179 ElementDefinition profile search paths from DataElement.element.mapping to ElementDefinition.mapping.
source_changes: source/hierarchy.xml: removed the DataElement resource page from the active Conformance hierarchy.
source/datatypes/coding-extensions-spreadsheet.xml: changed the profile description from DataElement to Coding.
source/datatypes/quantity-extensions-spreadsheet.xml: changed the profile description from DataElement to Quantity.
source/datatypes/elementdefinition-11179-profile-spreadsheet.xml: changed ISO 11179 search paths from DataElement.element.mapping extensions to ElementDefinition.mapping extensions.

related_jiras.note: A prior ActivityDefinition/DataElement boundary audit relied on FHIR-13094 as the later removal decision; it is already represented separately on the combined branch and was not re-decided here.
